source_resolution_rules: Use repository_path to verify copied bytes. Original relative paths and checksums remain unchanged for provenance.
For B3-02 source_inventory artifact_copy_path, resolve it under this bundle b3_02 directory.
For checksum-pinned original repository sources referenced by historical reviews, use git show baseline_commit:path; do not compare historical source checksums to legitimately updated current source.
Original full archive checksums describe origin archives, including operational items deliberately excluded here. Portable subset coverage is exactly entries above.

Tool-generated page/index excerpts are distinguished from full origin documents by their source manifests. Failed/empty retrievals confer no new evidence. No manuscripts or geocodes were retrieved for B5.
